title: Grand Granada!
text: Small group tours are the only way to go! Juan was an outstanding guide, well informed, personable, and funny. Learned a great deal about Granada and its complex history from a native! Priceless!!
author: Steve_N

title: Read carefully what is included, and not
text: No visits to the palaces. Only the surroundings are included. There's nothing wrong with that, it was a great ride. But hard to read when choosing between so many different tours. Could be better described
author: Per_N
